from datetime import date
from subscription_retention import Subscription, check_subscription, ReturnLikelihood

young = check_subscription(Subscription(date(2026, 1, 1), \"Budget\"), as_of=date(2026, 9, 29))
old = check_subscription(Subscription(date(2025, 1, 1), \"Temporary break\"), as_of=date(2026, 9, 29))
stay = check_subscription(Subscription(date(2025, 1, 1), \"Switched to competitor\"), as_of=date(2026, 9, 29))
unclear = check_subscription(Subscription(date(2025, 1, 1), \"No longer needed\"), as_of=date(2026, 9, 29))
print(young, old, stay, unclear, sep=\"\\n\")
assert not young.is_more_than_one_year_old
assert old.return_likelihood is ReturnLikelihood.LIKELY and old.will_probably_return
assert stay.return_likelihood is ReturnLikelihood.UNLIKELY and not stay.will_probably_return
assert unclear.return_likelihood is ReturnLikelihood.POSSIBLE
PY"
